content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've recently set up a stand-alone [product_name] to send a single SMS alarm notification from a vessel monitoring system. Usually, staff are present to respond to alarms, but the [product_name] serves as a backup. I want to configure it so that the SMS only goes out after a delay, maybe 30 seconds to a minute. If no one acknowledges the alarm at the monitoring station, the [product_name] should send an SMS. What's the method for programming this setup? The vessel system isn't based on [company_name] equipment and doesn't use any similar modules; the [product_name] simply receives an input and forwards it as an SMS.
It's not possible to set a sending delay for SMS in the [product_name]. You would need to create the delay externally, forwarding the alarm to the [product_name] after the desired period.
Thank you for the suggestion, that's very helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: The main challenge identified is that delayed SMS notifications cannot be directly configured in the [product_name]. Users need a built-in delay to avoid unnecessary notifications if alarms are quickly acknowledged by staff. Since this feature is missing, users have to look for external workarounds.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want an option to set a time delay in the [product_name], so SMS alerts are only sent if the primary alarm remains unacknowledged beyond a specified duration.
